reuse.why: Extends the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked guard into claimBankAccount and extracts the unlink field-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountLink, reused by both paths.

duplication.why: The account-unlink update is now defined once and shared by unlinkAccount and the replace path; no new duplicated logic.

placement.why: All logic stays in the accounts server app next to the existing link guards and unlink handler.

scope.why: Only the flag, the shared guard, the reorder of the closed-account check, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single claim helper used by every provider's link function with one boolean, and unlink semantics shared with the existing unlink action.
